papers.title: Proactive Memory for Event-Driven LLM Agents
papers.summary: Proposes ProactMem, a memory architecture for proactive LLM agents that organizes history into recent events, temporal trajectories, and behavioral regularities, verifying trajectory facts against source events and validating regularities via historical replay. On the new ProactiveStream benchmark it reaches 52.6% F1, a 21.4% relative improvement over baselines.

papers.title: Instruction Capacity: Behavior and Degradation of Language Models under Controlled Load
papers.summary: Introduces a statistical instrument that measures how many atomic, independent word-replacement rules a language model can follow, treating each replacement as a Bernoulli trial with a computable reference answer. It fits smooth laws for how accuracy degrades with text length, rule count, and density, yielding an instruction-capacity limit with uncertainty.
